The test `test_info` checks whether the `info` method of the `Fish` class correctly returns the name and version of the current shell. However, the test failure indicates that this is not the case. Following the execution path, we find that the `info` method is using the output of the `Popen` command to get the version of the `fish` shell, but it is adding an extra line break at the end which leads to the error demonstrated by the test.

The issue arises because the `decode('utf-8').strip()` operation does not remove the trailing newline character. To fix this, we can modify the method to use the `rstrip()` function instead of `strip()`.
